description: This file defines interfaces for cellular manager RBUS data manipulation, including initialization and unload functions, conditioned on the RBUS build flag. It includes license statements, include guards, and references to external rbus library.

methods.name: cellularmgr_Init
methods.description: Initializes the cellular manager RBUS interface.

methods.name: cellularmgr_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the cellular manager RBUS interface.
